subject: Internal Approval System attachment support
objective: Add private attachment upload and download to an existing internal approval system without allowing public object access.
accepted_scope: Add attachment metadata linked to an approval request
Generate five-minute signed upload and download URLs
Authorize access using the approval request role
Store object content in a private Cloud Storage staging bucket
Add unit, integration, and static policy tests
Produce evidence references for the staging candidate
out_of_scope: CMEK adoption without a new decision version
Automatic merge, approval, rollback, or production release

architecture_constraints.api: Existing Go service on Cloud Run
architecture_constraints.object_store: Private Cloud Storage bucket in asia-east1
architecture_constraints.access_pattern: Cloud Run authorizes first, then issues short-lived signed URL

known_drivers: Stored bytes over the 365-day retention window
Cloud Build and Artifact Registry usage
cost_constraints.required_follow_up: Recalculate with observed staging traffic and current Google Cloud pricing before production approval.

acceptance_tests.name: Applicant uploads an allowed file
acceptance_tests.expected: Metadata is linked to the request and the object is private.

acceptance_tests.name: Reviewer downloads an allowed file
acceptance_tests.expected: A five-minute signed URL is issued after role authorization.

acceptance_tests.name: Unrelated user requests the file
acceptance_tests.expected: The API returns 403 and does not issue a URL.

acceptance_tests.name: File exceeds 25 MB or has a disallowed type
acceptance_tests.expected: The request is rejected with a stable error and no object is accepted.

acceptance_tests.name: Candidate changes a forbidden path
acceptance_tests.expected: The candidate is blocked even if functional tests pass.
